acceptance: A test through the real entry shows one signal for an unmeasured cell, red without the fix.
N16 passes alone on the host, or the row names the host fault as its cause.
fix: Prove the cause. Emit a Signal Center event when a cell reads as unmeasured. Stop calling N16 a load flake.
summary: On 2026-11-06, contract row N16 passed alone at about 06:25 and failed alone from about 09:45, also on clean main and at low load: no fence of the cell after 1m0s. A direct probe: sandbox-exec denies the read (Operation not permitted), so enforcement holds. Its report does not appear in log show or log stream, with or without a message. Other processes still report as sender Sandbox. Host up 24 days; no OS update since 2026-10-16. Root cause not proven. It may be host state, and a reboot tests that. While it lasts, stage shadow of I-4 and I-5 reads count as unmeasured, a lane that touches the contract test fails the ship repo-contract gate (cycle 2191), and the warning goes to stderr with no Signal Center event, so the loop log shows nothing.
title: Sandbox read reports stopped reaching the unified log, so read isolation is unmeasured
